interpretation: The 64-byte successful HidD_GetInputReport response was independently decoded as report ID 1 followed by the Io4Input default state from Io4Codec.h: ADC[0]=0x7fff, remaining ADC/spinner/coin values zero, switches 0x4000 and 0x8000, system=2, usb=0, and 29 zero reserved bytes. The returned product string exactly matches kIo4ProductName. This verifies one current-state control GetInputReport snapshot for the identified IO4 collection.
limits: This is not an interrupt-IN transfer or continuous input stream. Default values do not demonstrate changing analog/switch state, physical button or axis operation, NKRO keyboard/mouse reports, game input, or electrical safety.
